what: When a text block is swapped, it ripples and changes as if seen through water — on receiving fx:swap, it fades out in .2s power1.in while refraction (feDisplacementMap) grows 0→26 (power2.in), swaps the content in .2s, returns in .5s power2.out, and the refraction settles in .7s power3.out. Meanwhile the grain of the water noise tightens from .012 .05 → .02 .09 over .8s (with .4px blur applied together)

options.settle: Length of time refraction settles (sec), default .7

use:
…
· el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("fx:swap", { detail: { apply: () => { /* Swap content */ } } }))

from.where: index.js work intro (.jb-works__info) — the #water-warp timeline from the original setWorkInfo

note: The part makes its own SVG filter inside the element (ids must not collide). To replay the text reveal after a change, call it inside apply
